title: little preview of what I've been cooking
author: Ajw03Dev
selftext:
Game is not anywhere yet and not even going to be playtested quite yet. The destruction physics use baked shatter data and compute shaders for the physics and the rendering so they're extra performant. made in unity 6 with some help from claude.

Game is called plunderspell and is somewhere between lethal, repo, and mage arena with progression more like how to fish. incremental upgrades, unlocking spells as you progress and eventually fighting that big guy in the sky once you grow powerful enough.

but until then it demands artifacts and when you don't pay up it'll come hunt you like it does here.

the rest of the castles loot is yours for the taking to sell or use and to get strong enough to break free.
